description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition of the land in Chilaw D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides details about statutory compensation deposited for specific acquired land parcels, including village name, land name, plan number, lot number, and extent. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition and property-related administrative procedures.
